36: +++ b/ale/vaos/README.md
37: @@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
38: +# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS
39: +
40: +This is the vrnetlab docker image for the ALE OmniSwitch virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x.
41: +Validated with vAOS 8.11.162.R01 (OS6870 simulation) and containerlab 0.77.0.
42: +
43: +## Building the docker image
44: +
45: +To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the
46: +[Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).
47: +
48: +vAOS comes as a GNS3 appliance made of four files. Copy them into this
49: +directory, renamed with a common `vaos-<version>` prefix:
50: +
51: +| GNS3 appliance file           | Rename to                              |
52: +|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
53: +| `vAOS8x.qcow2`                | `vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2`              |
54: +| `vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz`           | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz`         |
55: +| `vAOS8x_bzImage`              | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage`            |
56: +| `cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar` | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar`   |
57: +
58: +Then run `make`. The resulting image is `vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01`.
59: +
60: +## Usage with containerlab
61: +
62: +With the `ale_vaos` kind:
63: +
64: +```yaml
65: +topology:
66: +  kinds:
67: +    ale_vaos:
68: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
69: +      env:
70: +        CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: "true"
71: +  nodes:
72: +    os1:
73: +      kind: ale_vaos
74: +      startup-config: os1.cfg    # optional
75: +    os2:
76: +      kind: ale_vaos
77: +  links:
78: +    - endpoints: ["os1:1/1/1", "os2:1/1/1"]
79: +```
80: +
81: +With containerlab versions that do not have the `ale_vaos` kind yet, use the
82: +`generic_vm` kind and mount the startup configuration:
83: +
84: +```yaml
85: +    os1:
86: +      kind: generic_vm
87: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
88: +      binds:
89: +        - os1.cfg:/startup-config.cfg:ro
90: +```
91: +
92: +Default credentials: `admin` / `Switch@123`.
93: +
94: +A node needs about 3 minutes to boot and apply its configuration. It reports
95: +healthy once the bootstrap described below is done.
96: +
97: +### Interface mapping
98: +
99: +| Container interface | vAOS port |
100: +|---------------------|-----------|
101: +| eth1 to eth10       | 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 |
102: +| eth11               | 1/1/29A   |
103: +| eth12               | 1/1/30A   |
104: +| management          | EMP       |
105: +
106: +### Bootstrap
107: +
108: +Once the switch has booted (`+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` on the console),
109: +the launcher logs in on the serial console and:
110: +
111: +1. sets the system name and prompt to the node name,
112: +2. configures EMP with the management address (container address in
113: +   mgmt passthrough mode, 10.0.0.15/24 otherwise),
114: +3. adds the static routes from `EMP_ROUTES`,
115: +4. pushes the startup configuration: `/config/startup-config.cfg` (written by
116: +   containerlab from the node `startup-config`) or `/startup-config.cfg` (bind
117: +   mount with the `generic_vm` kind). AOS CLI, one command per line, lines
118: +   starting with `!` are skipped,
119: +5. runs `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`, then `write memory flash-synchro`.
120: +
121: +Optional environment variables:
122: +
123: +| Variable              | Default               | Description |
124: +|-----------------------|-----------------------|-------------|
125: +| `VAOS_USERNAME`       | `--username`, `admin`      | Console login |
126: +| `VAOS_PASSWORD`       | `--password`, `Switch@123` | Console password |
127: +| `EMP_ROUTES`          |                       | `prefix=gateway` list, comma separated. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped |
128: +| `VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG` | see step 4 above      | Path of the startup configuration |
129: +| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`     |                       | Extra CLI commands, `;` separated |
130: +| `VAOS_SAVE`           | `true`                | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |
131: +| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`      | `true`                | `false` skips the console bootstrap |
132: +
133: +### Saving the configuration
134: +
135: +With the containerlab `ale_vaos` kind, `containerlab save` creates
136: +`/config/.vaos-save-request`. The launcher then runs `write memory flash-synchro`,
137: +writes `show configuration snapshot` to `/config/startup-config.cfg` and reports
138: +the result in `/config/.vaos-save-done`.
139: +
140: +### Serial console
141: +
142: +The serial console is exposed on TCP port 5000: `telnet <node> 5000`.
143: +
144: +With mgmt passthrough, vAOS uses its own MAC address for EMP (ALE OUI `00:d0:1a`).
145: +Once EMP is configured, the launcher learns that MAC with an ARP probe on `tap0`
146: +and sets it on the container `eth0`, so that port 5000 stays reachable on the
147: +node management address.

172: @@ -0,0 +1,582 @@
173: +#!/usr/bin/env python3
174: +#
175: +# vrnetlab launcher for Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS 8.x.
176: +#
177: +# Boots the VM the way the GNS3 appliance (vAOS8x.gns3a) does:
178: +#   qemu -kernel vAOS8x_bzImage -initrd vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz \
179: +#        -append "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0" \
180: +#        -hda vAOS8x.qcow2 -hdb cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar  (both IDE, e1000 NICs)
181: +
182: +import ipaddress
183: +import logging
184: +import os
185: +import re
186: +import signal
187: +import socket
188: +import struct
189: +import subprocess
190: +import sys
191: +import time
192: +
193: +import vrnetlab
194: +
195: +
196: +def handle_SIGCHLD(signal, frame):
197: +    os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
198: +
199: +
200: +def handle_SIGTERM(signal, frame):
201: +    sys.exit(0)
202: +
203: +
204: +signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)
205: +signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)
206: +signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)
207: +
208: +TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = 9
209: +logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, "TRACE")
210: +
211: +
212: +def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):
213: +    if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):
214: +        self._log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, args, **kws)
215: +
216: +
217: +logging.Logger.trace = trace
218: +
219: +# Kernel command line copied verbatim from vAOS8x.gns3a.
220: +# (The inifile/connfile configs already live inside the VM disks.)
221: +KERNEL_APPEND = (
222: +    "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0"
223: +)
224: +
225: +# NIC index (adapter_number) -> OmniSwitch port name, from the vAOS8x.gns3a
226: +# custom_adapters block. Index is the guest NIC enumeration order; index 2 is
227: +# always the EMP (management) port.
228: +#
229: +# We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the
230: +# managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:
231: +#   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:
232: +#     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10
233: +#     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)
234: +PORT_MAP = {
235: +    0: "1/1/1",
236: +    1: "1/1/2",
237: +    2: "EMP",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here
238: +    3: "1/1/3",
239: +    4: "1/1/4",
240: +    5: "1/1/5",
241: +    6: "1/1/6",
242: +    7: "1/1/7",
243: +    8: "1/1/8",
244: +    9: "1/1/9",
245: +    10: "1/1/10",
246: +    11: "1/1/29A",
247: +    12: "1/1/30A",
248: +}
249: +
250: +# guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)
251: +MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2
252: +
253: +# ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------
254: +# After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.
255: +# All settings are optional environment variables (set them with "env:" in
256: +# the containerlab topology):
257: +#   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   "false" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)
258: +#   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)
259: +#   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)
260: +#   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, "prefix=gateway" separated by commas,
261: +#                    e.g. "192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254"
262: +#                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is
263: +#                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.
264: +#   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to
265: +#                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file
266: +#                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind "startup-config:",
267: +#                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).
268: +#                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg
269: +#                    or "show configuration snapshot". Empty lines and lines
270: +#                    starting with "!" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending
271: +#                    in "->" if the config changes it.
272: +#   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by ";"
273: +#   VAOS_SAVE        "false" to skip "write memory flash-synchro" (default: true)
274: +# Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are
275: +# deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.
276: +# Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab
277: +# ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind
278: +# mount with the generic_vm kind.
279: +STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = ["/config/startup-config.cfg", "/startup-config.cfg"]
280: +# "containerlab save" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config
281: +# dir. launch.py then runs "write memory flash-synchro", stores
282: +# "show configuration snapshot" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes "ok" (or the error)
283: +# in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.
284: +SAVE_REQUEST = "/config/.vaos-save-request"
285: +SAVE_DONE = "/config/.vaos-save-done"
286: +SAVED_CONFIG = "/config/startup-config.cfg"
287: +# async console messages, e.g. "Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:"
288: +ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\w{3} \w{3} +\d+ \d\d:\d\d:\d\d : ")
289: +LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w.\-]*-> ?$")
290: +LOGIN_RETRIES = 10
291: +LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15
292: +# CLI prompt: a line that starts with "->" or "<name>->". Not anchored at the
293: +# end of the buffer, because async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4
294: +# operationally up") can be printed right after the prompt.
295: +PROMPT_RE = rb"(?:^|\n)[\w.\-]*-> ?"
296: +# vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is
297: +# ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.
298: +NOT_READY_RE = (
299: +    rb"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization"
300: +)
301: +READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10
302: +READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds
303: +# Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the
304: +# GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.
305: +LINK_UP_RE = rb"\+\+\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up"
306: +BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds
307: +
308: +
309: +class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
310: +    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
311: +        disk_image = None
312: +        kernel = None
313: +        initrd = None
314: +        hdb = None
315: +        for e in sorted(os.listdir("/")):
316: +            if re.search(r"\.qcow2$", e) and "-overlay" not in e:
317: +                disk_image = "/" + e
318: +            elif re.search(r"bzImage$", e):
319: +                kernel = "/" + e
320: +            elif re.search(r"ramdisk.*\.gz$", e):
321: +                initrd = "/" + e
322: +            elif re.search(r"chassis_info.*\.tar$", e):
323: +                hdb = "/" + e
324: +
325: +        if not disk_image:
326: +            raise RuntimeError("No .qcow2 disk image found in /")
327: +
328: +        # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults
329: +        super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(
330: +            username,
331: +            password,
332: +            disk_image=disk_image,
333: +            ram=2048,
334: +            smp="2",
335: +            driveif="ide",
336: +        )
337: +
338: +        self.hostname = hostname
339: +        self.conn_mode = conn_mode
340: +        self.port_map = PORT_MAP
341: +        # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for
342: +        # interfaces actually wired in the topology.
343: +        self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)
344: +        self.nic_type = "e1000"
345: +        self._log_port_map()
346: +
347: +        # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second
348: +        # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.
349: +        # vrnetlab runs qemu via "shell=True", so the multi-word -append value
350: +        # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens
351: +        # like "GNS3=1" as bare disk-image args).
352: +        self.qemu_args.extend(
353: +            ["-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initrd, "-append", '"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '"']
354: +        )
355: +        if hdb:
356: +            self.qemu_args.extend(["-drive", "if=ide,file=" + hdb + ",format=raw"])
357: +
358: +        self.logger.info(
359: +            "vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s",
360: +            kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,
361: +        )
362: +
363: +    # ---- NIC placement --------------------------------------------------
364: +    # vrnetlab enumerates NICs by PCI slot. To get a clean
365: +    # container-ethN -> vAOS-1/1/N mapping with EMP as the management port, we
366: +    # force every NIC onto bridge pci.1 with explicit, ordered slots and
367: +    # reserve the slot at MGMT_NIC_INDEX for the management NIC (= EMP).
368: +
369: +    @staticmethod
370: +    def _eth_to_nic_index(eth_i):
371: +        """container eth index -> guest NIC index (skipping the EMP/mgmt slot)."""
372: +        return eth_i - 1 if eth_i - 1 < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else eth_i
373: +
374: +    @staticmethod
375: +    def _set_slot(dev_str, nic_index):
376: +        """Force a -device string onto pci.1 at slot (nic_index + 1)."""
377: +        dev_str = re.sub(r",bus=pci\.\d+", "", dev_str)
378: +        dev_str = re.sub(r",addr=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", "", dev_str)
379: +        return dev_str + ",bus=pci.1,addr=0x%x" % (nic_index + 1)
380: +
381: +    def gen_mgmt(self):
382: +        # Put the management NIC on the EMP slot (guest index 2).
383: +        res = super().gen_mgmt()
384: +        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
385: +            if tok == "-device":
386: +                res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], MGMT_NIC_INDEX)
387: +        return res
388: +
389: +    def gen_nics(self):
390: +        # Re-slot each data NIC so container ethN lands on its target guest index.
391: +        res = super().gen_nics()
392: +        # vrnetlab skips NICs above the highest wired ethN, and the guest numbers
393: +        # NICs in enumeration order. If eth1/eth2 are not wired, the management
394: +        # NIC shifts down and is no longer EMP. Always add unconnected dummies.
395: +        present = set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"netdev=p(\d+)", " ".join(res)))
396: +        for eth_i in range(1, MGMT_NIC_INDEX + 1):
397: +            if eth_i not in present:
398: +                res.extend([
399: +                    "-device", "%s,netdev=p%02d" % (self.nic_type, eth_i),
400: +                    "-netdev", "socket,id=p%02d,listen=:%d" % (eth_i, 10000 + eth_i),
401: +                ])
402: +        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
403: +            if tok == "-device":
404: +                m = re.search(r"netdev=p(\d+)", res[i + 1])
405: +                if m:
406: +                    eth_i = int(m.group(1))
407: +                    res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], self._eth_to_nic_index(eth_i))
408: +        return res
409: +
410: +    def _log_port_map(self):
411: +        """Log the container-interface <-> vAOS-port mapping for the operator."""
412: +        self.logger.info("vAOS NIC mapping (EMP = vrnetlab management):")
413: +        for nic in sorted(self.port_map):
414: +            port = self.port_map[nic]
415: +            if nic == MGMT_NIC_INDEX:
416: +                src = "vrnetlab management (NAT, or container eth0 in mgmt-passthrough)"
417: +            else:
418: +                eth = nic + 1 if nic < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else nic
419: +                src = "container eth%d" % eth
420: +            self.logger.info("  guest NIC%-2d  vAOS %-8s  <-  %s", nic, port, src)
421: +        self.logger.info("  => eth1=1/1/1, eth2=1/1/2, eth3=1/1/3 ... EMP = management")
422: +
423: +    def bootstrap_spin(self):
424: +        """Poll the serial console until the OmniSwitch login prompt appears."""
425: +        if self.spins > 6000:
426: +            self.logger.warning("Too many spins, restarting VM")
427: +            self.stop()
428: +            self.start()
429: +            return
430: +
431: +        (ridx, match, res) = self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 1)
432: +        # keep the boot output, in case the link-up line shows before login:
433: +        self._boot_out = getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"") + res
434: +        if match and ridx == 0:
435: +            self.logger.info("vAOS reached login prompt")
436: +            if os.environ.get("VAOS_BOOTSTRAP", "true").lower() != "false":
437: +                try:
438: +                    self.bootstrap_config()
439: +                except Exception as e:
440: +                    self.logger.error("vAOS bootstrap failed: %s", e)
441: +            self.running = True
442: +            self.tn.close()
443: +            return
444: +
445: +        if res != b"":
446: +            self.logger.trace("OUTPUT: %s" % res.decode(errors="ignore"))
447: +            self.spins = 0
448: +
449: +        self.spins += 1
450: +        return
451: +
452: +    # ---- containerlab save ----------------------------------------------
453: +
454: +    def work(self):
455: +        super().work()
456: +        if self.running and os.path.exists(SAVE_REQUEST):
457: +            self.save_config()
458: +
459: +    def save_config(self):
460: +        """Save the configuration and store a snapshot for containerlab save."""
461: +        self.logger.info("containerlab save requested")
462: +        try:
463: +            os.remove(SAVE_REQUEST)
464: +        except OSError:
465: +            pass
466: +        result = "ok"
467: +        try:
468: +            self.tn.open()
469: +            self.tn.write(b"\r")
470: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE, b"login:"], 15)
471: +            if ridx == 1:
472: +                username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
473: +                password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
474: +                if not self._login(username, password):
475: +                    raise RuntimeError("could not log in on the console")
476: +            elif ridx != 0:
477: +                raise RuntimeError("no prompt on the console (is a console session open?)")
478: +            self._send("write memory flash-synchro", timeout=180)
479: +            buf = self._send("show configuration snapshot", timeout=120)
480: +            config = self._extract_snapshot(buf)
481: +            if not config.strip():
482: +                raise RuntimeError("empty configuration snapshot")
483: +            with open(SAVED_CONFIG, "w") as f:
484: +                f.write(config)
485: +            self.logger.info("configuration saved to %s", SAVED_CONFIG)
486: +            self.tn.write(b"exit\r")
487: +        except Exception as e:
488: +            result = "error: %s" % e
489: +            self.logger.error("containerlab save failed: %s", e)
490: +        finally:
491: +            try:
492: +                self.tn.close()
493: +            except Exception:
494: +                pass
495: +            with open(SAVE_DONE, "w") as f:
496: +                f.write(result + "\n")
497: +
498: +    @staticmethod
499: +    def _extract_snapshot(buf):
500: +        """Keep the configuration lines of "show configuration snapshot".
501: +
502: +        Async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4 operationally up") can be
503: +        printed in the middle of a line: "spb+++ Link ...\n isis ..." is
504: +        rejoined as "spb isis ...".
505: +        """
506: +        lines = buf.decode(errors="ignore").replace("\r", "").split("\n")
507: +        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
508: +            if "show configuration snapshot" in line:
509: +                lines = lines[i + 1:]
510: +                break
511: +        out = []
512: +        i = 0
513: +        while i < len(lines):
514: +            line = lines[i]
515: +            i += 1
516: +            if LINE_PROMPT_RE.match(line):
517: +                break  # CLI prompt after the output
518: +            if line.startswith("+++") or ASYNC_HEADER_RE.match(line):
519: +                continue  # async console message on its own line
520: +            pos = line.find("+++")
521: +            if pos > 0:
522: +                # message inserted mid-line: the rest of the line follows it
523: +                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("+++"):
524: +                    i += 1
525: +                rest = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ""
526: +                i += 1
527: +                line = line[:pos] + rest
528: +            out.append(line)
529: +        while out and not out[-1].strip():
530: +            out.pop()
531: +        while out and not out[0].strip():
532: +            out.pop(0)
533: +        return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
534: +
535: +    # ---- console bootstrap ---------------------------------------------
536: +
537: +    def _send(self, cmd, timeout=30):
538: +        """Send one CLI command and wait for the "->" prompt. If vAOS says it
539: +        is not ready yet, wait and send the command again."""
540: +        deadline = time.time() + READY_TIMEOUT
541: +        while True:
542: +            self.logger.info("vAOS> %s", cmd)
543: +            self.tn.write((cmd + "\r").encode())
544: +            ridx, _, buf = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE], timeout)
545: +            if ridx != 0:
546: +                self.logger.warning("no prompt after '%s' (continuing)", cmd)
547: +                return buf
548: +            if not re.search(NOT_READY_RE, buf):
549: +                return buf
550: +            if time.time() > deadline:
551: +                self.logger.error("vAOS still not ready after %ds, giving up on '%s'",
552: +                                  READY_TIMEOUT, cmd)
553: +                return buf
554: +            self.logger.info("vAOS not ready yet, retrying in %ds", READY_RETRY_DELAY)
555: +            time.sleep(READY_RETRY_DELAY)
556: +
557: +    def _sync_emp_mac(self, emp):
558: +        """mgmt passthrough: copy the EMP MAC address to the container eth0.
559: +
560: +        vrnetlab gives the container eth0 the MAC of the VM management NIC, so
561: +        that traffic for the ports kept in the container (5000-5007, serial
562: +        console) is accepted by the container. vAOS does not use that MAC for
563: +        EMP but its own, so the launcher learns it with an ARP probe sent to
564: +        the VM on tap0 and sets it on eth0.
565: +        """
566: +        ip = socket.inet_aton(emp.split("/")[0])
567: +        try:
568: +            with open("/sys/class/net/%s/address" % self.mgmt_intf) as f:
569: +                src = bytes.fromhex(f.read().strip().replace(":", ""))
570: +            # ETH_P_ALL: frames from the VM are redirected to eth0 by tc on tap0
571: +            # ingress; only an ETH_P_ALL socket sees them before that
572: +            sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.htons(0x0003))
573: +            sock.bind(("tap0", 0))
574: +            sock.settimeout(1)
575: +        except OSError as e:
576: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync skipped: %s", e)
577: +            return
578: +        # ARP probe: who-has <EMP IP>, sender IP 0.0.0.0
579: +        probe = (b"\xff" * 6 + src + b"\x08\x06"
580: +                 + struct.pack("!HHBBH", 1, 0x0800, 6, 4, 1)
581: +                 + src + b"\x00" * 4 + b"\x00" * 6 + ip)
582: +        mac = None
583: +        deadline = time.time() + 30
584: +        try:
585: +            while mac is None and time.time() < deadline:
586: +                sock.send(probe)
587: +                end = time.time() + 2
588: +                while time.time() < end:
589: +                    try:
590: +                        pkt = sock.recv(2048)
591: +                    except socket.timeout:
592: +                        break
593: +                    # ARP (reply, or gratuitous ARP) sent by the VM from the EMP IP
594: +                    if len(pkt) >= 42 and pkt[12:14] == b"\x08\x06" \
595: +                            and pkt[28:32] == ip and pkt[22:28] != src:
596: +                        mac = pkt[22:28]
597: +                        break
598: +        finally:
599: +            sock.close()
600: +        if mac is None:
601: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: no ARP reply from EMP")
602: +            return
603: +        mac_str = ":".join("%02x" % b for b in mac)
604: +        res = subprocess.run(["ip", "link", "set", "dev", self.mgmt_intf, "address", mac_str],
605: +                             capture_output=True, text=True)
606: +        if res.returncode != 0:
607: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: %s", res.stderr.strip())
608: +            return
609: +        self.logger.info("EMP MAC %s copied to container %s", mac_str, self.mgmt_intf)
610: +
611: +    def _login(self, username, password):
612: +        """Log in on the console. The first login prompt can come before AAA
613: +        is ready, so retry a few times."""
614: +        for attempt in range(1, LOGIN_RETRIES + 1):
615: +            self.logger.info("vAOS console login attempt %d as %s", attempt, username)
616: +            self.tn.write((username + "\r").encode())
617: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([b"assword:"], 30)
618: +            if ridx != 0:
619: +                self.tn.write(b"\r")
620: +                self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
621: +                continue
622: +            self.tn.write((password + "\r").encode())
623: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect(
624: +                [PROMPT_RE, rb"Authentication failure|Login incorrect"], 60
625: +            )
626: +            if ridx == 0:
627: +                self.logger.info("vAOS console login OK")
628: +                return True
629: +            self.logger.warning("vAOS login failed, retrying in %ds", LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
630: +            time.sleep(LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
631: +            self.tn.write(b"\r")
632: +            self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
633: +        return False
634: +
635: +    def _push_config(self, path):
636: +        """Send a startup config to the CLI, one line at a time."""
637: +        with open(path, errors="ignore") as f:
638: +            lines = [l.strip() for l in f]
639: +        cmds = [l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith("!")]
640: +        self.logger.info("pushing startup config %s (%d commands)", path, len(cmds))
641: +        errors = 0
642: +        for cmd in cmds:
643: +            buf = self._send(cmd, timeout=60)
644: +            if re.search(rb"\bERROR\b", buf):
645: +                errors += 1
646: +                self.logger.warning("startup config line rejected: %s", cmd)
647: +        self.logger.info("startup config pushed: %d commands, %d rejected",
648: +                         len(cmds), errors)
649: +
650: +    def bootstrap_config(self):
651: +        """Log in on the serial console and configure EMP (+ optional extras)."""
652: +        username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
653: +        password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
654: +
655: +        # EMP address: the node management address (mgmt passthrough), or
656: +        # 10.0.0.15/24, where vrnetlab forwards ssh/snmp/... in NAT mode
657: +        emp = self.mgmt_address_ipv4
658: +        if not emp or emp == "dhcp":
659: +            emp = None
660: +        elif "/" not in emp:
661: +            emp += "/24"
662: +
663: +        if re.search(LINK_UP_RE, getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"")):
664: +            self.logger.info("vAOS boot complete (Link 1/1/1 operationally up)")
665: +        else:
666: +            self.logger.info("waiting for '+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up' (max %ds)",
667: +                             BOOT_TIMEOUT)
668: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([LINK_UP_RE], BOOT_TIMEOUT)
669: +            if ridx == 0:
670: +                self.logger.info("vAOS boot complete (Link 1/1/1 operationally up)")
671: +            else:
672: +                self.logger.warning("Link 1/1/1 not up after %ds, trying anyway",
673: +                                    BOOT_TIMEOUT)
674: +        # get a fresh login prompt
675: +        self.tn.write(b"\r")
676: +        self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
677: +
678: +        if not self._login(username, password):
679: +            raise RuntimeError("could not log in as %s" % username)
680: +
681: +        hostname = os.environ.get("HOSTNAME") or self.hostname
682: +        self._send("system name %s" % hostname)
683: +        self._send('session prompt default "%s->"' % hostname)
684: +
685: +        if emp:
686: +            self._send("ip interface emp address %s" % emp)
687: +            if self.mgmt_passthrough:
688: +                self._sync_emp_mac(emp)
689: +        else:
690: +            self.logger.info("no EMP address to configure (DHCP mode)")
691: +
692: +        for route in filter(None, os.environ.get("EMP_ROUTES", "").split(",")):
693: +            prefix, _, gw = route.strip().partition("=")
694: +            try:
695: +                net = ipaddress.IPv4Network(prefix.strip(), strict=False)
696: +                gw_ip = ipaddress.IPv4Address(gw.strip())
697: +            except ValueError:
698: +                self.logger.warning("ignoring malformed EMP_ROUTES entry '%s'", route)
699: +                continue
700: +            if net.prefixlen == 0:
701: +                self.logger.warning(
702: +                    "ignoring EMP_ROUTES entry '%s': a default route is not "
703: +                    "allowed on EMP, use specific prefixes", route)
704: +                continue
705: +            self._send("ip static-route %s gateway %s" % (net, gw_ip))
706: +
707: +        cfg_path = os.environ.get("VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG")
708: +        if cfg_path and not os.path.isfile(cfg_path):
709: +            self.logger.warning("startup config %s not found in the container", cfg_path)
710: +        for path in ([cfg_path] if cfg_path else STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS):
711: +            if path and os.path.isfile(path) and os.path.getsize(path) > 0:
712: +                self._push_config(path)
713: +                break
714: +
715: +        for cmd in os.environ.get("VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS", "").split(";"):
716: +            if cmd.strip():
717: +                self._send(cmd.strip())
718: +
719: +        if os.environ.get("VAOS_SAVE", "true").lower() != "false":
720: +            self._send("write memory flash-synchro", timeout=180)
721: +
722: +        self._send("show ip interface")
723: +        self.logger.info("vAOS bootstrap done (EMP %s)", emp)
724: +
725: +
726: +class VAOS(vrnetlab.VR):
727: +    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
728: +        super(VAOS, self).__init__(username, password)
729: +        self.vms = [VAOS_vm(hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode)]
730: +
731: +
732: +if __name__ == "__main__":
733: +    import argparse
734: +
735: +    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="vAOS vrnetlab launcher")
736: +    parser.add_argument("--trace", action="store_true", help="enable trace logging")
737: +    parser.add_argument("--hostname", default="vaos", help="VM hostname")
738: +    parser.add_argument("--username", default="admin", help="Username")
739: +    parser.add_argument("--password", default="Switch@123", help="Password")
740: +    parser.add_argument("--nics", type=int, default=13, help="Number of NICs")
741: +    parser.add_argument(
742: +        "--connection-mode", default="tc", help="vrnetlab datapath connection mode"
743: +    )
744: +    args = parser.parse_args()
745: +
746: +    LOG_FORMAT = "%(asctime)s: %(module)-10s %(levelname)-8s %(message)s"
747: +    logging.basicConfig(format=LOG_FORMAT)
748: +    logger = logging.getLogger()

753: +    vr = VAOS(args.hostname, args.username, args.password, args.nics, args.connection_mode)

+# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS
+
+This is the vrnetlab docker image for the ALE OmniSwitch virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x.
+Validated with vAOS 8.11.162.R01 (OS6870 simulation) and containerlab 0.77.0.
+
+## Building the docker image
+
+To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the
+[Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).
+
+vAOS comes as a GNS3 appliance made of four files. Copy them into this
+directory, renamed with a common `vaos-<version>` prefix:
+
+| GNS3 appliance file           | Rename to                              |
+|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
+| `vAOS8x.qcow2`                | `vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2`              |
+| `vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz`           | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz`         |
+| `vAOS8x_bzImage`              | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage`            |
+| `cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar` | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar`   |
+
+Then run `make`. The resulting image is `vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01`.
+
+## Usage with containerlab
+
+With the `ale_vaos` kind:
+
+```yaml
+topology:
+  kinds:
+    ale_vaos:
+      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
+      env:
+        CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: "true"
+  nodes:
+    os1:
+      kind: ale_vaos
+      startup-config: os1.cfg    # optional
+    os2:
+      kind: ale_vaos
+  links:
+    - endpoints: ["os1:1/1/1", "os2:1/1/1"]
+```
+
+With containerlab versions that do not have the `ale_vaos` kind yet, use the
+`generic_vm` kind and mount the startup configuration:
+
+```yaml
+    os1:
+      kind: generic_vm
+      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
+      binds:
+        - os1.cfg:/startup-config.cfg:ro
+```
+
+Default credentials: `admin` / `Switch@123`.
+
+A node needs about 3 minutes to boot and apply its configuration. It reports
+healthy once the bootstrap described below is done.
+
+### Interface mapping
+
+| Container interface | vAOS port |
+|---------------------|-----------|
+| eth1 to eth10       | 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 |
+| eth11               | 1/1/29A   |
+| eth12               | 1/1/30A   |
+| management          | EMP       |
+
+### Bootstrap
+
+Once the switch has booted (`+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` on the console),
+the launcher logs in on the serial console and:
+
+1. sets the system name and prompt to the node name,
+2. configures EMP with the management address (container address in
+   mgmt passthrough mode, 10.0.0.15/24 otherwise),
+3. adds the static routes from `EMP_ROUTES`,
+4. pushes the startup configuration: `/config/startup-config.cfg` (written by
+   containerlab from the node `startup-config`) or `/startup-config.cfg` (bind
+   mount with the `generic_vm` kind). AOS CLI, one command per line, lines
+   starting with `!` are skipped,
+5. runs `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`, then `write memory flash-synchro`.
+
+Optional environment variables:
+
+| Variable              | Default               | Description |
+|-----------------------|-----------------------|-------------|
+| `VAOS_USERNAME`       | `--username`, `admin`      | Console login |
+| `VAOS_PASSWORD`       | `--password`, `Switch@123` | Console password |
+| `EMP_ROUTES`          |                       | `prefix=gateway` list, comma separated. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped |
+| `VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG` | see step 4 above      | Path of the startup configuration |
+| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`     |                       | Extra CLI commands, `;` separated |
+| `VAOS_SAVE`           | `true`                | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |
+| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`      | `true`                | `false` skips the console bootstrap |
+
+### Saving the configuration
+
+With the containerlab `ale_vaos` kind, `containerlab save` creates
+`/config/.vaos-save-request`. The launcher then runs `write memory flash-synchro`,
+writes `show configuration snapshot` to `/config/startup-config.cfg` and reports
+the result in `/config/.vaos-save-done`.
+
+### Serial console
+
+The serial console is exposed on TCP port 5000: `telnet <node> 5000`.
+
+With mgmt passthrough, vAOS uses its own MAC address for EMP (ALE OUI `00:d0:1a`).
+Once EMP is configured, the launcher learns that MAC with an ARP probe on `tap0`
+and sets it on the container `eth0`, so that port 5000 stays reachable on the
+node management address.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+#
+# vrnetlab launcher for Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS 8.x.
+#
+# Boots the VM the way the GNS3 appliance (vAOS8x.gns3a) does:
+#   qemu -kernel vAOS8x_bzImage -initrd vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz \
+#        -append "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0" \
+#        -hda vAOS8x.qcow2 -hdb cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar  (both IDE, e1000 NICs)
+
+import ipaddress
+import logging
+import os
+import re
+import signal
+import socket
+import struct
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+import vrnetlab
+
+
+def handle_SIGCHLD(signal, frame):
+    os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
+
+
+def handle_SIGTERM(signal, frame):
+    sys.exit(0)
+
+
+signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)
+signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)
+signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)
+
+TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = 9
+logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, "TRACE")
+
+
+def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):
+    if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):
+        self._log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, args, **kws)
+
+
+logging.Logger.trace = trace
+
+# Kernel command line copied verbatim from vAOS8x.gns3a.
+# (The inifile/connfile configs already live inside the VM disks.)
+KERNEL_APPEND = (
+    "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0"
+)
+
+# NIC index (adapter_number) -> OmniSwitch port name, from the vAOS8x.gns3a
+# custom_adapters block. Index is the guest NIC enumeration order; index 2 is
+# always the EMP (management) port.
+#
+# We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the
+# managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:
+#   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:
+#     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10
+#     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)
+PORT_MAP = {
+    0: "1/1/1",
+    1: "1/1/2",
+    2: "EMP",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here
+    3: "1/1/3",
+    4: "1/1/4",
+    5: "1/1/5",
+    6: "1/1/6",
+    7: "1/1/7",
+    8: "1/1/8",
+    9: "1/1/9",
+    10: "1/1/10",
+    11: "1/1/29A",
+    12: "1/1/30A",
+}
+
+# guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)
+MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2
+
+# ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------
+# After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.
+# All settings are optional environment variables (set them with "env:" in
+# the containerlab topology):
+#   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   "false" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)
+#   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)
+#   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)
+#   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, "prefix=gateway" separated by commas,
+#                    e.g. "192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254"
+#                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is
+#                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.
+#   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to
+#                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file
+#                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind "startup-config:",
+#                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).
+#                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg
+#                    or "show configuration snapshot". Empty lines and lines
+#                    starting with "!" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending
+#                    in "->" if the config changes it.
+#   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by ";"
+#   VAOS_SAVE        "false" to skip "write memory flash-synchro" (default: true)
+# Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are
+# deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.
+# Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab
+# ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind
+# mount with the generic_vm kind.
+STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = ["/config/startup-config.cfg", "/startup-config.cfg"]
+# "containerlab save" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config
+# dir. launch.py then runs "write memory flash-synchro", stores
+# "show configuration snapshot" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes "ok" (or the error)
+# in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.
+SAVE_REQUEST = "/config/.vaos-save-request"
+SAVE_DONE = "/config/.vaos-save-done"
+SAVED_CONFIG = "/config/startup-config.cfg"
+# async console messages, e.g. "Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:"
+ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\w{3} \w{3} +\d+ \d\d:\d\d:\d\d : ")
+LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w.\-]*-> ?$")
+LOGIN_RETRIES = 10
+LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15
+# CLI prompt: a line that starts with "->" or "<name>->". Not anchored at the
+# end of the buffer, because async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4
+# operationally up") can be printed right after the prompt.
+PROMPT_RE = rb"(?:^|\n)[\w.\-]*-> ?"
+# vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is
+# ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.
+NOT_READY_RE = (
+    rb"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization"
+)
+READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10
+READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds
+# Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the
+# GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.
+LINK_UP_RE = rb"\+\+\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up"
+BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds
+
+
+class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
+    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
+        disk_image = None
+        kernel = None
+        initrd = None
+        hdb = None
+        for e in sorted(os.listdir("/")):
+            if re.search(r"\.qcow2$", e) and "-overlay" not in e:
+                disk_image = "/" + e
+            elif re.search(r"bzImage$", e):
+                kernel = "/" + e
+            elif re.search(r"ramdisk.*\.gz$", e):
+                initrd = "/" + e
+            elif re.search(r"chassis_info.*\.tar$", e):
+                hdb = "/" + e
+
+        if not disk_image:
+            raise RuntimeError("No .qcow2 disk image found in /")
+
+        # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults
+        super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(
+            username,
+            password,
+            disk_image=disk_image,
+            ram=2048,
+            smp="2",
+            driveif="ide",
+        )
+
+        self.hostname = hostname
+        self.conn_mode = conn_mode
+        self.port_map = PORT_MAP
+        # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for
+        # interfaces actually wired in the topology.
+        self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)
+        self.nic_type = "e1000"
+        self._log_port_map()
+
+        # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second
+        # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.
+        # vrnetlab runs qemu via "shell=True", so the multi-word -append value
+        # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens
+        # like "GNS3=1" as bare disk-image args).
+        self.qemu_args.extend(
+            ["-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initrd, "-append", '"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '"']
+        )
+        if hdb:
+            self.qemu_args.extend(["-drive", "if=ide,file=" + hdb + ",format=raw"])
+
+        self.logger.info(
+            "vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s",
+            kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,
+        )
+
+    # ---- NIC placement --------------------------------------------------
+    # vrnetlab enumerates NICs by PCI slot. To get a clean
+    # container-ethN -> vAOS-1/1/N mapping with EMP as the management port, we
+    # force every NIC onto bridge pci.1 with explicit, ordered slots and
+    # reserve the slot at MGMT_NIC_INDEX for the management NIC (= EMP).
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _eth_to_nic_index(eth_i):
+        """container eth index -> guest NIC index (skipping the EMP/mgmt slot)."""
+        return eth_i - 1 if eth_i - 1 < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else eth_i
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _set_slot(dev_str, nic_index):
+        """Force a -device string onto pci.1 at slot (nic_index + 1)."""
+        dev_str = re.sub(r",bus=pci\.\d+", "", dev_str)
+        dev_str = re.sub(r",addr=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", "", dev_str)
+        return dev_str + ",bus=pci.1,addr=0x%x" % (nic_index + 1)
+
+    def gen_mgmt(self):
+        # Put the management NIC on the EMP slot (guest index 2).
+        res = super().gen_mgmt()
+        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
+            if tok == "-device":
+                res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], MGMT_NIC_INDEX)
+        return res
+
+    def gen_nics(self):
+        # Re-slot each data NIC so container ethN lands on its target guest index.
+        res = super().gen_nics()
+        # vrnetlab skips NICs above the highest wired ethN, and the guest numbers
+        # NICs in enumeration order. If eth1/eth2 are not wired, the management
+        # NIC shifts down and is no longer EMP. Always add unconnected dummies.
+        present = set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"netdev=p(\d+)", " ".join(res)))
+        for eth_i in range(1, MGMT_NIC_INDEX + 1):
+            if eth_i not in present:
+                res.extend([
+                    "-device", "%s,netdev=p%02d" % (self.nic_type, eth_i),
+                    "-netdev", "socket,id=p%02d,listen=:%d" % (eth_i, 10000 + eth_i),
+                ])
+        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
+            if tok == "-device":
+                m = re.search(r"netdev=p(\d+)", res[i + 1])
+                if m:
+                    eth_i = int(m.group(1))
+                    res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], self._eth_to_nic_index(eth_i))
+        return res
+
+    def _log_port_map(self):
+        """Log the container-interface <-> vAOS-port mapping for the operator."""
+        self.logger.info("vAOS NIC mapping (EMP = vrnetlab management):")
+        for nic in sorted(self.port_map):
+            port = self.port_map[nic]
+            if nic == MGMT_NIC_INDEX:
+                src = "vrnetlab management (NAT, or container eth0 in mgmt-passthrough)"
+            else:
+                eth = nic + 1 if nic < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else nic
+                src = "container eth%d" % eth
+            self.logger.info("  guest NIC%-2d  vAOS %-8s  <-  %s", nic, port, src)
+        self.logger.info("  => eth1=1/1/1, eth2=1/1/2, eth3=1/1/3 ... EMP = management")
+
+    def bootstrap_spin(self):
+        """Poll the serial console until the OmniSwitch login prompt appears."""
+        if self.spins > 6000:
+            self.logger.warning("Too many spins, restarting VM")
+            self.stop()
+            self.start()
+            return
+
+        (ridx, match, res) = self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 1)
+        # keep the boot output, in case the link-up line shows before login:
+        self._boot_out = getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"") + res
+        if match and ridx == 0:
+            self.logger.info("vAOS reached login prompt")
+            if os.environ.get("VAOS_BOOTSTRAP", "true").lower() != "false":
+                try:
+                    self.bootstrap_config()
+                except Exception as e:
+                    self.logger.error("vAOS bootstrap failed: %s", e)
+            self.running = True
+            self.tn.close()
+            return
+
+        if res != b"":
+            self.logger.trace("OUTPUT: %s" % res.decode(errors="ignore"))
+            self.spins = 0
+
+        self.spins += 1
+        return
+
+    # ---- containerlab save ----------------------------------------------
+
+    def work(self):
+        super().work()
+        if self.running and os.path.exists(SAVE_REQUEST):
+            self.save_config()
+
+    def save_config(self):
+        """Save the configuration and store a snapshot for containerlab save."""
+        self.logger.info("containerlab save requested")
+        try:
+            os.remove(SAVE_REQUEST)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+        result = "ok"
+        try:
+            self.tn.open()
+            self.tn.write(b"\r")
+            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE, b"login:"], 15)
+            if ridx == 1:
+                username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
+                password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
+                if not self._login(username, password):
+                    raise RuntimeError("could not log in on the console")
+            elif ridx != 0:
+                raise RuntimeError("no prompt on the console (is a console session open?)")
+            self._send("write memory flash-synchro", timeout=180)
+            buf = self._send("show configuration snapshot", timeout=120)
+            config = self._extract_snapshot(buf)
+            if not config.strip():
+                raise RuntimeError("empty configuration snapshot")
+            with open(SAVED_CONFIG, "w") as f:
+                f.write(config)
+            self.logger.info("configuration saved to %s", SAVED_CONFIG)
+            self.tn.write(b"exit\r")
+        except Exception as e:
+            result = "error: %s" % e
+            self.logger.error("containerlab save failed: %s", e)
+        finally:
+            try:
+                self.tn.close()
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            with open(SAVE_DONE, "w") as f:
+                f.write(result + "\n")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _extract_snapshot(buf):
+        """Keep the configuration lines of "show configuration snapshot".
+
+        Async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4 operationally up") can be
+        printed in the middle of a line: "spb+++ Link ...\n isis ..." is
+        rejoined as "spb isis ...".
+        """
+        lines = buf.decode(errors="ignore").replace("\r", "").split("\n")
+        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+            if "show configuration snapshot" in line:
+                lines = lines[i + 1:]
+                break
+        out = []
+        i = 0
+        while i < len(lines):
+            line = lines[i]
+            i += 1
+            if LINE_PROMPT_RE.match(line):
+                break  # CLI prompt after the output
+            if line.startswith("+++") or ASYNC_HEADER_RE.match(line):
+                continue  # async console message on its own line
+            pos = line.find("+++")
+            if pos > 0:
+                # message inserted mid-line: the rest of the line follows it
+                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("+++"):
+                    i += 1
+                rest = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ""
+                i += 1
+                line = line[:pos] + rest
+            out.append(line)
+        while out and not out[-1].strip():
+            out.pop()
+        while out and not out[0].strip():
+            out.pop(0)
+        return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
+
+    # ---- console bootstrap ---------------------------------------------
+
+    def _send(self, cmd, timeout=30):
+        """Send one CLI command and wait for the "->" prompt. If vAOS says it
+        is not ready yet, wait and send the command again."""
+        deadline = time.time() + READY_TIMEOUT
+        while True:
+            self.logger.info("vAOS> %s", cmd)
+            self.tn.write((cmd + "\r").encode())
+            ridx, _, buf = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE], timeout)
+            if ridx != 0:
+                self.logger.warning("no prompt after '%s' (continuing)", cmd)
+                return buf
+            if not re.search(NOT_READY_RE, buf):
+                return buf
+            if time.time() > deadline:
+                self.logger.error("vAOS still not ready after %ds, giving up on '%s'",
+                                  READY_TIMEOUT, cmd)
+                return buf
+            self.logger.info("vAOS not ready yet, retrying in %ds", READY_RETRY_DELAY)
+            time.sleep(READY_RETRY_DELAY)
+
+    def _sync_emp_mac(self, emp):
+        """mgmt passthrough: copy the EMP MAC address to the container eth0.
+
+        vrnetlab gives the container eth0 the MAC of the VM management NIC, so
+        that traffic for the ports kept in the container (5000-5007, serial
+        console) is accepted by the container. vAOS does not use that MAC for
+        EMP but its own, so the launcher learns it with an ARP probe sent to
+        the VM on tap0 and sets it on eth0.
+        """
+        ip = socket.inet_aton(emp.split("/")[0])
+        try:
+            with open("/sys/class/net/%s/address" % self.mgmt_intf) as f:
+                src = bytes.fromhex(f.read().strip().replace(":", ""))
+            # ETH_P_ALL: frames from the VM are redirected to eth0 by tc on tap0
+            # ingress; only an ETH_P_ALL socket sees them before that
+            sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.htons(0x0003))
+            sock.bind(("tap0", 0))
+            sock.settimeout(1)
+        except OSError as e:
+            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync skipped: %s", e)
+            return
+        # ARP probe: who-has <EMP IP>, sender IP 0.0.0.0
+        probe = (b"\xff" * 6 + src + b"\x08\x06"
+                 + struct.pack("!HHBBH", 1, 0x0800, 6, 4, 1)
+                 + src + b"\x00" * 4 + b"\x00" * 6 + ip)
+        mac = None
+        deadline = time.time() + 30
+        try:
+            while mac is None and time.time() < deadline:
+                sock.send(probe)
+                end = time.time() + 2
+                while time.time() < end:
+                    try:
+                        pkt = sock.recv(2048)
+                    except socket.timeout:
+                        break
+                    # ARP (reply, or gratuitous ARP) sent by the VM from the EMP IP
+                    if len(pkt) >= 42 and pkt[12:14] == b"\x08\x06" \
+                            and pkt[28:32] == ip and pkt[22:28] != src:
+                        mac = pkt[22:28]
+                        break
+        finally:
+            sock.close()
+        if mac is None:
+            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: no ARP reply from EMP")
+            return
+        mac_str = ":".join("%02x" % b for b in mac)
+        res = subprocess.run(["ip", "link", "set", "dev", self.mgmt_intf, "address", mac_str],
+                             capture_output=True, text=True)
+        if res.returncode != 0:
+            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: %s", res.stderr.strip())
+            return
+        self.logger.info("EMP MAC %s copied to container %s", mac_str, self.mgmt_intf)
+
+    def _login(self, username, password):
+        """Log in on the console. The first login prompt can come before AAA
+        is ready, so retry a few times."""
+        for attempt in range(1, LOGIN_RETRIES + 1):
+            self.logger.info("vAOS console login attempt %d as %s", attempt, username)
+            self.tn.write((username + "\r").encode())
+            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([b"assword:"], 30)
+            if ridx != 0:
+                self.tn.write(b"\r")
+                self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
+                continue
+            self.tn.write((password + "\r").encode())
+            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect(
+                [PROMPT_RE, rb"Authentication failure|Login incorrect"], 60
+            )
+            if ridx == 0:
+                self.logger.info("vAOS console login OK")
+                return True
+            self.logger.warning("vAOS login failed, retrying in %ds", LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
+            time.sleep(LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
+            self.tn.write(b"\r")
+            self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
+        return False
+
+    def _push_config(self, path):
+        """Send a startup config to the CLI, one line at a time."""
+        with open(path, errors="ignore") as f:
+            lines = [l.strip() for l in f]
+        cmds = [l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith("!")]
+        self.logger.info("pushing startup config %s (%d commands)", path, len(cmds))
+        errors = 0
+        for cmd in cmds:
+            buf = self._send(cmd, timeout=60)
+            if re.search(rb"\bERROR\b", buf):
+                errors += 1
+                self.logger.warning("startup config line rejected: %s", cmd)
+        self.logger.info("startup config pushed: %d commands, %d rejected",
+                         len(cmds), errors)
+
+    def bootstrap_config(self):
+        """Log in on the serial console and configure EMP (+ optional extras)."""
+        username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
+        password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
+
+        # EMP address: the node management address (mgmt passthrough), or
+        # 10.0.0.15/24, where vrnetlab forwards ssh/snmp/... in NAT mode
+        emp = self.mgmt_address_ipv4
+        if not emp or emp == "dhcp":
+            emp = None
+        elif "/" not in emp:
+            emp += "/24"
+
+        if re.search(LINK_UP_RE, getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"")):
+            self.logger.info("vAOS boot complete (Link 1/1/1 operationally up)")
+        else:
+            self.logger.info("waiting for '+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up' (max %ds)",
+                             BOOT_TIMEOUT)
+            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([LINK_UP_RE], BOOT_TIMEOUT)
+            if ridx == 0:
+                self.logger.info("vAOS boot complete (Link 1/1/1 operationally up)")
+            else:
+                self.logger.warning("Link 1/1/1 not up after %ds, trying anyway",
+                                    BOOT_TIMEOUT)
+        # get a fresh login prompt
+        self.tn.write(b"\r")
+        self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
+
+        if not self._login(username, password):
+            raise RuntimeError("could not log in as %s" % username)
+
+        hostname = os.environ.get("HOSTNAME") or self.hostname
+        self._send("system name %s" % hostname)
+        self._send('session prompt default "%s->"' % hostname)
+
+        if emp:
+            self._send("ip interface emp address %s" % emp)
+            if self.mgmt_passthrough:
+                self._sync_emp_mac(emp)
+        else:
+            self.logger.info("no EMP address to configure (DHCP mode)")
+
+        for route in filter(None, os.environ.get("EMP_ROUTES", "").split(",")):
+            prefix, _, gw = route.strip().partition("=")
+            try:
+                net = ipaddress.IPv4Network(prefix.strip(), strict=False)
+                gw_ip = ipaddress.IPv4Address(gw.strip())
+            except ValueError:
+                self.logger.warning("ignoring malformed EMP_ROUTES entry '%s'", route)
+                continue
+            if net.prefixlen == 0:
+                self.logger.warning(
+                    "ignoring EMP_ROUTES entry '%s': a default route is not "
+                    "allowed on EMP, use specific prefixes", route)
+                continue
+            self._send("ip static-route %s gateway %s" % (net, gw_ip))
+
+        cfg_path = os.environ.get("VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG")
+        if cfg_path and not os.path.isfile(cfg_path):
+            self.logger.warning("startup config %s not found in the container", cfg_path)
+        for path in ([cfg_path] if cfg_path else STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS):
+            if path and os.path.isfile(path) and os.path.getsize(path) > 0:
+                self._push_config(path)
+                break
+

+            if cmd.strip():

VENDOR=ALE
NAME=vAOS
IMAGE_FORMAT=qcow2
IMAGE_GLOB=*.qcow2

# The vAOS image is made of four files taken from the GNS3 appliance. Rename
# them with the same prefix, for example for 8.11.162.R01:
#   vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2              (vAOS8x.qcow2)
#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz         (vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz)
#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage            (vAOS8x_bzImage)
#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar   (cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar)
# match versions like 8.11.162.R01
VERSION=$(shell echo $(IMAGE) | sed -e 's/^vaos-//' -e 's/\.qcow2$$//')

-include ../../makefile-sanity.include
-include ../../makefile.include

# The common build only copies $(IMAGE)* into docker/. Copy the kernel,
# initrd and chassis information disk that come with the qcow2.
docker-pre-build:
	cp $(basename $(IMAGE))-ramdisk.gz $(basename $(IMAGE))-bzImage \

55: # always the EMP (management) port.

57: # We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the
58: # managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:
59: #   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:
60: #     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10
61: #     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)

63:     0: "1/1/1",
64:     1: "1/1/2",
65:     2: "EMP",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here
66:     3: "1/1/3",
67:     4: "1/1/4",
68:     5: "1/1/5",
69:     6: "1/1/6",
70:     7: "1/1/7",
71:     8: "1/1/8",
72:     9: "1/1/9",
73:     10: "1/1/10",
74:     11: "1/1/29A",
75:     12: "1/1/30A",
76: }

78: # guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)
79: MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2

81: # ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------
82: # After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.
83: # All settings are optional environment variables (set them with "env:" in
84: # the containerlab topology):
85: #   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   "false" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)
86: #   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)
87: #   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)
88: #   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, "prefix=gateway" separated by commas,
89: #                    e.g. "192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254"
90: #                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is
91: #                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.
92: #   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to
93: #                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file
94: #                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind "startup-config:",
95: #                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).
96: #                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg
97: #                    or "show configuration snapshot". Empty lines and lines
98: #                    starting with "!" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending
99: #                    in "->" if the config changes it.
100: #   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by ";"
101: #   VAOS_SAVE        "false" to skip "write memory flash-synchro" (default: true)
102: # Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are
103: # deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.
104: # Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab
105: # ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind
106: # mount with the generic_vm kind.
107: STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = ["/config/startup-config.cfg", "/startup-config.cfg"]
108: # "containerlab save" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config
109: # dir. launch.py then runs "write memory flash-synchro", stores
110: # "show configuration snapshot" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes "ok" (or the error)
111: # in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.
112: SAVE_REQUEST = "/config/.vaos-save-request"
113: SAVE_DONE = "/config/.vaos-save-done"
114: SAVED_CONFIG = "/config/startup-config.cfg"
115: # async console messages, e.g. "Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:"
116: ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\w{3} \w{3} +\d+ \d\d:\d\d:\d\d : ")
117: LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w.\-]*-> ?$")
118: LOGIN_RETRIES = 10
119: LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15
120: # CLI prompt: a line that starts with "->" or "<name>->". Not anchored at the
121: # end of the buffer, because async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4
122: # operationally up") can be printed right after the prompt.
123: PROMPT_RE = rb"(?:^|\n)[\w.\-]*-> ?"
124: # vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is
125: # ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.
126: NOT_READY_RE = (
127:     rb"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization"
128: )
129: READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10
130: READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds
131: # Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the
132: # GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.
133: LINK_UP_RE = rb"\+\+\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up"
134: BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds

137: class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
138:     def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
139:         disk_image = None
140:         kernel = None
141:         initrd = None
142:         hdb = None
143:         for e in sorted(os.listdir("/")):
144:             if re.search(r"\.qcow2$", e) and "-overlay" not in e:

146:             elif re.search(r"bzImage$", e):
147:                 kernel = "/" + e
148:             elif re.search(r"ramdisk.*\.gz$", e):
149:                 initrd = "/" + e
150:             elif re.search(r"chassis_info.*\.tar$", e):
151:                 hdb = "/" + e

153:         if not disk_image:
154:             raise RuntimeError("No .qcow2 disk image found in /")
155: 
156:         # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults
157:         super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(
158:             username,
159:             password,
160:             disk_image=disk_image,
161:             ram=2048,
162:             smp="2",
163:             driveif="ide",
164:         )
165: 
166:         self.hostname = hostname
167:         self.conn_mode = conn_mode
168:         self.port_map = PORT_MAP
169:         # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for
170:         # interfaces actually wired in the topology.
171:         self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)
172:         self.nic_type = "e1000"
173:         self._log_port_map()
174: 
175:         # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second
176:         # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.
177:         # vrnetlab runs qemu via "shell=True", so the multi-word -append value
178:         # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens
179:         # like "GNS3=1" as bare disk-image args).
180:         self.qemu_args.extend(
181:             ["-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initrd, "-append", '"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '"']
182:         )
183:         if hdb:
184:             self.qemu_args.extend(["-drive", "if=ide,file=" + hdb + ",format=raw"])
185: 
186:         self.logger.info(
187:             "vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s",
188:             kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,
189:         )
